system.name: TerminalTraj
system.one_liner: Scalable pipeline that builds Dockerized environments from repositories, generates Docker-aligned task instances and synthesizes verified terminal agent trajectories.

content.variant_note: three tinted regions (sources, Docker images, instances) joined by orthogonal black arrows, with captioned icons and logos as nodes
content.argues: A fully automated pipeline can turn open-source repositories into executable Docker environments and verifiable terminal tasks at large scale.
content.subject: Data-source collection, Docker image curation with repo scoring, and LLM-based instance generation ending in agent trajectories.

lessons.what_to_learn: Split a data pipeline into three tinted regions with matching deeper borders, fill them with captioned icons and real logos as nodes, and mark the model steps with one distinct orange bar so they stay findable among many icons.
lessons.suits: Data-synthesis and curation pipelines with many heterogeneous sources and tools, where the reader should see the sources, the filtering and the generated instances as three parts.

evidence: our pipeline consists of 3 parts: (i) Data Sources Collection, aggregating diverse raw signals; (ii) Docker Image Curation
the top-right part shows Docker image curation, and the bottom-right part presents instance generation
Repositories scoring below τ = 0.2 are discarded regarding practical trade-off

summary: TerminalTraj turns open-source repositories into executable, verifiable terminal tasks and agent trajectories. Figure 1 is a data-construction pipeline drawn as three tinted regions joined by black arrows and filled with small captioned icons and brand logos. The teal region on the left collects sources: GitHub repositories in chosen languages, eight specific domains found by keywords and an LLM, and external documents. The blue region at the top right scores repositories with a Score Model, filters them (a per-language accept and discard bar chart) and extracts Dockerfiles to build Docker images. The salmon region at the bottom right feeds domain-related and Docker-related code files to LLMs, marked with EXAMPLE stickers, to make domain-specific and general instances, then an agent rolls trajectories that are verified.
summary_zh: TerminalTraj 把开源仓库变成可执行、可验证的终端任务与智能体轨迹。图 1 为数据构造流水线：左侧青绿区收集数据源，右上蓝色区给仓库打分、过滤并建 Docker 镜像，右下橙红区用 LLM 生成实例，再由智能体采样轨迹并验证。
